prompts.name: 01-basic-home
prompts.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Create one photorealistic wide landscape image, 16:9, a convincing cinematic environmental photograph of Assam's Brahmaputra valley circa 1993. User reference images show rural Assamese houses: woven bamboo and earth plaster walls, dark exposed timber frames, pale infill panels, timber shutter windows, deep verandas, sloping corrugated metal roofs, some raised timber bungalows, lush areca palms, banana, bamboo, broadleaf trees and swept earthen courtyards. Use these architectural cues faithfully. Show the whole dwelling in its broader natural landscape, not a closeup. Flat fertile terrain, layered lush vegetation, humid air, natural colors, restrained film texture, believable building structure. Homes should be occupied and cared for according to household resources, not abandoned ruins simply because the references are weathered. Respectful everyday atmosphere. No text, collage, labels, social media UI, watermark, smartphones, satellite dishes, solar panels, modern SUVs, contemporary villas, glass facades, or high rises. This is one frame in a coherent five-image series across household means.
Scene: A household with very limited means: a small single-storey bamboo-post home with woven bamboo wall panels partly coated in earth plaster, thick thatched pitched roof and a tiny shaded veranda, on a low raised earthen plinth. Simple bamboo gate and fence, swept earth yard, a few clay vessels, small kitchen garden, a few chickens, banana plants and dense bamboo, areca palms, green paddy fields beyond. Human dignity and daily use, no exaggerated squalor. Soft morning light. The home occupies the middle third of a generous landscape composition.
